text:
Jamie: Heads-up — planning a small canary tomorrow 14:00 PT for the continuous-batching tweak. Need deploy owner, smoke keeper, and rollback lead. Goal: validate latency tail improvements without regressions.

Leo: I can own the deploy and immediate rollbacks. What cohorts are we targeting?

Jamie: Thanks. Thinking phased cohorts: 1) internal-service traffic only, 2) 1% external (US-west + mobile), 3) 5% (EU region), 4) 25% global, then 50% if stable.

Sophia: I'll do smoke checks for internal-service and 1% external. Will monitor token latency p50/p95 and error rates.

Maya: Quick config note — this change toggles continuous_batching=on plus kv-cache TTL bump. Small migration in runtime. I've added a preflight to ensure KV schema compatibility.

Jamie: Nice. Here is the ramp schedule I propose (will run watchers at each step):

```
Ramp plan:
- 00:00 -> 1% (10m) — smoke by Sophia
- +10m -> 5% (20m) — expanded checks (logs + e2e)
- +30m -> 25% (30m) — perf sweep
- +60m -> 50% (monitor 30m)
Stop/rollback if any threshold hit.
```

Ryan: What's the rollback command/process? Also who can trigger?

Leo: I can trigger rollback. Plan: if p50 latency increases >30ms OR p95 >200ms OR error rate spike >1% sustained over 2 consecutive windows (5m), we rollback. Rollback command (ops-runbook):

```
# run from infra jump host
redwoodctl rollout rollback --service inference-runtime --to previous
# confirm with: redwoodctl status --service inference-runtime
```

Sophia: I'll post periodic checks in thread with short snapshots. Example check I'll paste during smoke: `p50=78ms p95=162ms errors=0.12%`

Maya: Add-on notes: if KV warmup causes initial higher latencies, we allow a 5m warmup at each step before evaluating. Also toggle flag is server-side, so no client-side changes.

Jamie: Everyone ack? If no objections I'll merge the tiny config PR now and schedule the deploy. @deploy-bot can you queue for 2026-03-19T21:00:00Z (14:00 PT)? :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Deployment queued by Jamie for 2026-03-19T21:00:00Z. Job id: job_3940019. Auto-notify: #eng-releases + oncall if rollback invoked.

Leo: Ack. I'll be on call during the window and ready to rollback.

Sophia: Ack — will post smoke snapshots and quick logs.

Ryan: Quick Q — any db migrations?

Maya: No DB migrations, just KV TTL bump (safe).

Jamie: Thanks. Merge going through now. Will ping here 30m before start with final checklist.

Sophia: copy — smoke checklist high level: 1) health endpoints green, 2) p50/p95 within thresholds, 3) errors <0.5%, 4) sample payloads sanity, 5) traces for tail latency. I'll post a short template.

Leo: Adding rollback rights note: only deploy owner (me) or oncall lead can execute rollback without extra approvals.

Jamie: Cool. If anything unexpected, call out immediately in thread and escalate to #eng-oncall.

Ryan: Thanks all — I'll keep an eye on mobile client metrics after 1% goes live.

deploy-bot: Reminder scheduled: 2026-03-19T20:30:00Z — 30m to canary start.

Jamie: End of plan.
